comparison.objective: Candidate removes a latched fan; record installs a spring cage fastener into a square opening.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained bracket release and vertical withdrawal versus bilateral spring-leg compression, hook insertion, and elastic retention.
comparison.success_condition: Fan out with cage and neighbors intact versus both hooks retained behind the coupon, fixture unmoved, and hands released.
comparison.reason: Both involve spring retention, but installation through an aperture under symmetric compression is materially different from extracting a guided module.
